TC torace a bassa dose di screening: esa: Low-dose screening chest CT: baseline exam in a 64-year-old male former smoker
Screening negativo per noduli con repert: Screening negative for nodules with a significant incidental finding: coronary calcifications in multiple vessels (Lung-RADS 1S) (NLST 100710)
Uomo di 64 anni, ex fumatore (criteri di: 64-year-old man, former smoker (NLST entry criteria: age 55-74, at least 30 pack-years, quit less than 15 years ago). First CT of the screening program (baseline), low-dose without contrast. No prior exam. Exam date is conventional.
Referta l'esame di screening: noduli, al: Report the screening exam: nodules, other significant findings and Lung-RADS category.
Lo screening polmonare con TC a bassa do:
Lung screening with low-dose CT is performed in heavy smokers, who also have a high cardiovascular risk: in the NLST, cardiovascular diseases were as frequent a cause of death as lung cancer. Coronary calcifications are clearly visible even on a non-contrast CT that is not ECG-gated: they must always be reported, at least qualitatively (absent, mild, moderate, severe) or with a visual score, because they change prevention.

Lung-RADS v2022: category 1 (no nodule) with modifier S for a significant non-pulmonary finding; next screening CT in 12 months.

Other incidental findings to always look for in screening: emphysema (the NLST readers annotated it in this patient, but with this noise it is hard to assess), aortic dilatation, lesions of the thyroid, breast, liver, adrenals and kidneys in the included portions, vertebral fragility fractures.
Screening polmonare: oltre ai noduli, ce: Lung screening: besides nodules, always look for and report coronary calcifications (modifier S).
Nessun tumore polmonare nei circa 6,4 an: No lung cancer in about 6.4 years of follow-up (NLST public data, canc_free_days 2323). T0 screening classified as “negative with significant abnormalities not suspicious for cancer” (emphysema and significant cardiovascular abnormality).
Immagine 86, finestra mediastinica: calc: Image 86, mediastinal window: coronary calcifications in the left atrioventricular groove
Reperto incidentale importante ma non ur: Important but non-urgent incidental finding: it must be written clearly in the report with the recommendation.
Qual è la conclusione più adatta?: What is the most appropriate conclusion?
Anche i lettori NLST non hanno trovato n: The NLST readers also found no nodules in any of the three exams.
Nodulo solido sospetto del lobo superior: Suspicious solid nodule of the upper lobe
Non ci sono noduli: le piccole opacità r: There are no nodules: the small round opacities are vessels in cross-section, which can be followed on the neighboring images.
Calcificazioni coronariche in più sedi (: Coronary calcifications at multiple sites (left atrioventricular groove and right atrioventricular groove)
Finestra mediastinica, immagini 82-102:: Mediastinal window, images 82-102: calcifications in the left atrioventricular groove (probably circumflex) and in the right atrioventricular groove (right coronary artery). The NLST readers annotated a “significant cardiovascular abnormality”.
Calcificazioni coronariche: reperto da n: Coronary calcifications: finding not to be reported because it does not concern the lung
Le calcificazioni coronariche sono il re: Coronary calcifications are the most important incidental finding of screening: they predict cardiovascular events, a frequent cause of death in these patients, and change therapy (statin, cardiology evaluation).
Lung-RADS 1S: nessun nodulo, TC di scree: Lung-RADS 1S: no nodule, screening CT in 12 months; report the coronary calcifications (modifier S) and refer for cardiovascular risk assessment
Lung-RADS v2022: il modificatore S si ag: Lung-RADS v2022: modifier S is added to any category when there is a significant non-pulmonary finding; for coronary calcifications it is usually used when they are at least moderate, as here (multiple vessels, many images). Outcome: no lung cancer in about 6.4 years of follow-up.
